{{< include _db-setup.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| output: false

L = require("https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js")

home_lat  = 51.5
home_lng  = 3
home_zoom = 9

elements = [
  { label: "Copper (CU)",      value: "CU" },
  { label: "Zinc (ZN)",        value: "ZN" }
]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mutable clicked_point = null
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: sidebar

viewof selected_element = Inputs.select(elements, {
  label: "Element:",
  format: d => d.label,
  value: elements[0]
})

// --- Year range ---
year_range_result = db.query(`
  SELECT MIN(year) AS min_year, MAX(year) AS max_year
  FROM sediment s1
  JOIN sample s2 ON s2.sample_id = s1.sample_id
  JOIN project p1 ON p1.project_id = s2.project_id
  WHERE s1.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
`)

min_year = year_range_result[0].min_year ?? 1984
max_year = year_range_result[0].max_year ?? 2024

viewof year_start = Inputs.range(
  [min_year, max_year],
  { label: "Year from:", step: 1, value: min_year }
)

viewof year_end = Inputs.range(
  [min_year, max_year],
  { label: "Year to:", step: 1, value: max_year }
)

// --- Project list (updates when element changes) ---
organisation_result = db.query(`
  SELECT DISTINCT project
  FROM sediment s1
  JOIN sample s2 ON s2.sample_id = s1.sample_id
  JOIN project p1 ON p1.project_id = s2.project_id
  WHERE s1.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
  AND project IS NOT NULL
`)

project_options = ["All", ...organisation_result.map(r => r.project)]

viewof selected_project = Inputs.select(project_options, {
  label: "Project:",
  value: "All"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: fill

// Reusable project WHERE fragment — empty string when "All" is selected
project_filter = selected_project === "All"
  ? ""
  : `AND project = '${selected_project}'`

// --- Value range query (for legend and colour scale) ---
value_range_result = db.query(`
  SELECT
    param,
    MIN(avg_value) AS min_avg_value,
    MAX(avg_value) AS max_avg_value
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        parameter AS param,
          AVG(
            CASE
              WHEN s1.unit = 'mg/g dw' THEN s1.value * 1000
              WHEN s1.unit = 'µg/g dw' THEN s1.value
              ELSE NULL
            END
          ) AS avg_value
    FROM sediment s1
    JOIN sample s2 ON s2.sample_id = s1.sample_id
    JOIN station s3 ON s3.station_id = s2.station_id
    JOIN project p1 ON p1.project_id = s2.project_id
    WHERE s1.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
           AND year BETWEEN ${year_start} AND ${year_end}
           ${project_filter}
    GROUP BY parameter, latitude, longitude
  ) t
  GROUP BY t.param
`)

value_min = value_range_result[0]?.min_avg_value ?? 0
value_max = value_range_result[0]?.max_avg_value ?? 1

// --- Map data query ---
map_data = db.query(`
    SELECT latitude,
           longitude,
           AVG(
            CASE
              WHEN s1.unit = 'mg/g dw' THEN s1.value * 1000
              WHEN s1.unit = 'µg/g dw' THEN s1.value
              ELSE NULL
            END
           ) AS avg_value_ug_per_kg
    FROM sediment s1
    JOIN sample s2 ON s2.sample_id = s1.sample_id
    JOIN station s3 ON s3.station_id = s2.station_id
    JOIN project p1 ON p1.project_id = s2.project_id
    WHERE s1.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
      AND year >= ${year_start}
      AND year <= ${year_end}
      AND s1.value IS NOT NULL
      ${project_filter}
    GROUP BY latitude, longitude

`)

// --- Colour scale using element + year + country specific range ---
colorScale = d3.scaleSequential()
  .domain([value_min, value_max])
  .interpolator(d3.interpolateYlOrRd)

function markerColor(v) {
  return v == null ? "#aaa" : colorScale(v)
}

function fmtVal(v) {
  return v == null ? "N/A"
    : v >= 1000  ? (v / 1000).toFixed(0) + " mg/g"
    : v.toFixed(0) + " µg/g"
}

// --- Render / update map ---
{
  const container = html`<div class="map-container"><div id="map"></div></div>`
  yield container

  if (!container._map) {
    const map = L.map(container.querySelector("#map"), { zoomControl: true })
      .setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)

    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
    }).addTo(map)

    const HomeControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "topleft" },
      onAdd(map) {
        const btn = L.DomUtil.create("a", "leaflet-home-button")
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-expand" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
        btn.title = "Reset to default view"
        btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Reset to default view")
        L.DomEvent.on(btn, "click", (e) => {
          L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e)
          map.setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
        })
        return btn
      }
    })
    new HomeControl().addTo(map)

    const LegendControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "bottomright" },
      onAdd() {
        const div = L.DomUtil.create("div", "legend")
        div.id = "map-legend"
        return div
      }
    })
    new LegendControl().addTo(map)

    container._map     = map
    container._markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map)
  }

  const { _map: map, _markers: markers } = container

  // Update legend — includes organisation in subtitle when filtered
  const legendEl = map.getContainer().querySelector("#map-legend")
  if (legendEl) {
    const organisationLabel = selected_project === "All" ? "All projects" : selected_project
    legendEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="legend-title">${selected_element.label}</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:#555">
        Avg (µg/kg) · ${year_start}–${year_end} · ${organisationLabel}
      </div>
      <div class="legend-bar"></div>
      <div class="legend-labels">
        <span>${fmtVal(value_min)}</span> &nbsp;
        <span>${fmtVal((value_min + value_max) / 2)}</span> &nbsp;
        <span>${fmtVal(value_max)}</span>
      </div>
    `
  }

  markers.clearLayers()
  mutable clicked_point = null

  for (const d of map_data) {
    if (d.avg_value_ug_per_kg == null) continue
    const circle = L.circleMarker([d.latitude, d.longitude], {
      radius:      7,
      fillColor:   markerColor(d.avg_value_ug_per_kg),
      color:       "#333",
      weight:      0.8,
      opacity:     1,
      fillOpacity: 0.85
    })
    circle.bindTooltip(
      `<b>${selected_element.label}</b><br>
       Avg: ${fmtVal(d.avg_value_ug_per_kg)}<br>
       (${year_start}–${year_end})`,
      { sticky: true }
    )
    circle.on("click", () => {
      mutable clicked_point = { lon: d.longitude, lat: d.latitude }
    })
    markers.addLayer(circle)
  }
}

map_data.length === 0
  ? md`*No data found for this selection.*`
  : md`**${selected_element.label}** · ${year_start}–${year_end} · ${selected_project} · **${map_data.length}** locations · values in µg/kg`
```

```{ojs}
// --- Detail table on click ---

point_data = {
  const p = clicked_point
  if (!p) return []
  // In the detail query the project station is s2, so adjust the organisation filter alias
  const detail_project_filter = selected_project === "All"
    ? ""
    : `AND project = '${selected_project}'`
  return db.query(`
    SELECT project AS Project,
           CAST(CAST(year AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) AS Year,
           month AS Month,
           station_code AS Station,
           ROUND(latitude, 2) AS Latitude,
           ROUND(longitude, 2) AS Longitude,
           gear_code AS Gear,
           p2.parameter AS Param,
           UPPER(SUBSTR(parameter_name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(parameter_name, 2)) AS Name,
           replicate_number AS "No",
           depth_range AS "Depth Range",
           value AS Value,
           unit AS Unit
    FROM sediment s1
    JOIN sample s2 ON s2.sample_id = s1.sample_id
    JOIN station s3 ON s3.station_id = s2.station_id
    JOIN project p1 ON p1.project_id = s2.project_id
    JOIN parameter p2 ON p2.parameter = s1.parameter
    WHERE s1.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
      AND year >= ${year_start}
      AND year <= ${year_end}
      AND longitude = ${p.lon}
      AND latitude  = ${p.lat}
      AND value IS NOT NULL
      ${detail_project_filter}
    ORDER BY year, replicate_number
  `)
}

clicked_point
  ? md`### Measurements at (${clicked_point.lat.toFixed(2)}, ${clicked_point.lon.toFixed(2)})`
  : md`*Click a point on the map to see its measurements.*`

clicked_point ? Inputs.table(point_data, { layout: "auto" }) : html`<span></span>`
```
